narrationScript: Welcome to Chapter 1.4: Power and Energy Constraints. In modern computer architecture, power consumption is a critical factor, impacting everything from battery life to data center costs. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to distinguish between power and energy, calculate dynamic and static power using the fundamental CMOS equations, understand the powerful technique of Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling, and describe Thermal Design Power, or TDP, and its crucial role in system design. Let's dive into how these factors shape the performance and efficiency of our processors.
